title: Create Together A SMP Modpack
description: Create Together is a lightweight, multiplayer-friendly modpack built around the Create Mod, perfect for friends who want to build, automate, and explore.
body:
🛠️ Create Together – Lightweight Modpack for Friends
Version: [insert Minecraft version here]

Welcome to Create Together, a lightweight, server-friendly modpack built around the incredible Create Mod! Designed for small groups of friends, this modpack keeps things simple, stable, and fun—focusing on creative engineering, automation, and collaborative builds without overwhelming your server or your PC.

🔧 Key Features:

Create Mod at the core – Build mechanical contraptions, factories, trains, and more!

Minimal bloat – Only essential performance and quality-of-life mods added

Low system requirements – Smooth performance on modest setups

Multiplayer-optimized – Perfect for cooperative play and shared projects

A sprinkle of exploration – Optional light world-gen tweaks to keep things fresh

Whether you're building steampunk factories, experimenting with kinetic machines, or just having a laugh with friends, Create Together gives you the tools to turn ideas into motion – without the clutter.
